description_raw: As part of long-term investments in Georgia Power’s statewide transmission system, this project includes rebuilding the existing approximately 2.5‑mile Decatur – Scottdale 115 kV transmission line between the Scottdale Substation in DeKalb County and the Decatur Substation on East College Avenue, as well as relocating approximately 0.7 miles of line. This is a rebuild project driven by the age of the existing infrastructure, which was originally constructed in 1965. This project is part of Georgia Power’s ongoing commitment to strengthen and expand the electric grid. By replacing aging infrastructure with more modern materials and design, the project will enhance system reliability, support Georgia’s evolving energy needs, and help ensure safe, resilient electric service for decades to come.
